instruction: A cinematic outdoor still in a grassy park. In the left foreground, a heavy-set Black man in a dark blue t-shirt (R1) is shown in profile, holding a blue frisbee in his hands. Leaning toward him from the right is a woman with dark hair in a dark blue t-shirt (R4), looking at him with an intense expression. In the background, a woman with an afro in a red t-shirt (R6), a man in a red t-shirt (R3), and a woman in a black beanie and red t-shirt (R5) stand watching the interaction. Bright daylight illuminates the green lawn and trees.
